# Tropical ToDos
> A calm, local-first to-do list with a cinematic beach backdrop. Private by design — tasks stay in your browser.

Canonical: https://troplist.com/

## Product
- Natural-language quick-add (dates, times, #tags)
- Work / Home / Misc boxes (suggest + drag-and-drop; time can auto-file)
- Date buckets: Overdue, Today, This Week, Later, Someday
- Fuzzy search, keyboard-first, offline PWA
- Backup/restore JSON; optional folder auto-backup

## Privacy
No account. No server-side task storage. Data lives in IndexedDB on the device.
